reviews.text: Excellent.  Professional and very caring for my cat.  They are very thorough as well.
The staff is wonderful and very attentive to our dogs

We bring our 10 month old puppy Goldie and our 6 year old boxer Franko to canine retreat when we leave town and they absolutely love it. Everyone who works there is kind and remembers both of the dogs. Love it!
Our puppy Kiki loves Canine Retreat!  She plays all day with her puppy friends and she loves the staff!  They are the best. Always so kind and nice.
I love the time and care the groomers take with my dog! Love the fact it is cage free!

The Canine Retreat team is fantastic! I recently boarded my two cats and they were well taken care of. They stayed in a deluxe suite and had plenty of space to hang out. I also signed them up for “play time” to give them a change of scenery. I knew my fur babies were in good hands based on prior stays and I will definitely use Canine Retreat again for their boarding needs.
Great place for my labradoodle Millie. Very nice staff.

My almost twelve years old rescue doggy has been going to Canine Retreat over the last five years.  He came with some special food needs and just a bit more gentle attention. Frankly, a mess (5 years ago).   The wonderful staff are professional, consistently kind and “we” have thrived in both in day care and long stays.  My pup has blossomed, enjoys the staff and socializing with the other doggies.   It’s been an amazing partnership.  I am grateful for their services.

Have boarded our 2yr old 60lb bernedoodle several times at Canine Retreat. He’s also been several times for daycare.
Every experience has been good, the staff are great to deal with and I always feel like our dog is in good hands when we drop him off. Our dog gets super excited when we arrive and is always very tired when he gets home. He’s very social, so it’s a good place for him to burn off some of that pup energy. Glad I found Canine Retreat when I was looking for boarding options and plan to keep using their service.

We've taken our dog here many times for overnight boarding and he absolutely loves it! He can't wait to get inside. They take such good care of him, and we love being able to check in on him through the pet cam. They also offer exit baths so he comes home nice and clean, which is really helpful after longer stays. We were referred by a friend after being hesitant to try overnight boarding and now it's our go-to. Would definitely recommend to anyone in the area.

We have used Canine Retreat for boarding and daycare.  Our three-year old husky Sweetie loves it here.  Canine Retreat vets dogs carefully, so I know Sweetie will be with dogs that are well-behaved and up to date on their vaccinations.  The staff is friendly and helpful and their extended hours make drop off and pick up really convenient.
Nice cat boarding facility with lots of space.
Thank you, Ryan and Mary for the 5 stars! We always enjoy seeing Luna.

We had our two Cavalier King Charles’ spend the night this past week! It was a great experience for the dogs and comforting for us to check in via video a few times to see how well they were doing! The staff is great and comforting to know they were in a safe, fun environment with trusted staff! Bruce

We've trusted Canine Retreat with our dog, Slater, for three years, and they've been consistently professional, responsible, and caring the entire time. It starts with the staff: the same familiar faces greet us at the front desk every morning, creating a familiar environment full of positive energy.

Canine Retreat's operations are impeccable. Staff closely monitor and enforce good pack behavior. They know every dog. They remember who plays well together, which dogs don't get along, and they know Slater likes extra rest breaks from the pack in the afternoon. Webcams provide a clear, full view of every park for added peace of mind. Boarding is kennel-free, and a staff member sleeps over with the dogs in a large room.

Drop-offs and pick-ups are always efficient. Afternoon pick-ups will start with notes on your dog's good, sometimes naughty, and always hilarious, behavior. Staff are so on top of managing their clients they remind me and my wife about vaccinations before our vet does. We wouldn't trust anyone but Canine Retreat with our Slater-pup!

I am so thrilled I found Canine Retreat.  I hated the thought of leaving my baby.  I hated more the thought of of him alone in a cage.  This place rocks.  He is with other dogs ( his size) socializing and hanging with staff.  The staff is amazingly attentive and so helpful with the whole process.  My dog Theodore has grown socially in their care.  I’m so glad to have found this retreat.
I love bringing Sally here! They are all the BEST!!!
Everyone at this facility is so wonderful my puppy loves going to this place ❤

I go to Canine Retreat every single week. They are always kind and helpful. My dog can’t wait to get out of the car and see his friends. They treat him so well. And he’s exhausted for days after being there. 10/10.

Mango, my chubby, happy, Golden Retriever absolutely loves coming here. She’s fired up when we get here, she’s excited when I ick her up.
They threat her like royalty. And I know they do that with every pup that shows up. It’s part of their culture there.
You can tell they’re dog lovers and that matters.
The facility is cool. Mango stays over night when we go out of town. All the dogs sleep together and they are watch movies I believe.

Canine Retreat gets our  full endorsement.
Good people.
Joy loves coming to daycare about twice a week. I also board her here when I travel. I'm so thankful there's someone there all the time. She loves the staff & so do I. ♥️
I take my dog here like every day, she’s older and she enjoys the company with the other dogs and she loves the staff. They are all so friendly here and welcoming.

I have taken my dogs to Canine retreat since they opened and can not imagine going anywhere else. They have loved on my dogs as if they are their own and my dogs love going there every time. I highly recommend Canine retreat to take care of beloved pets. They are phenomenal!
Juneau loves being there! They take great care of her, and I love being able to check on her via the webcam!!
Easy drop off and pickup and our dog enjoys her stays.
Our dog has been a guest at Canine Retreat for many years - he always seems content to enter their doors, and he seems quite comfortable spending his days there!
Thank you for the support! We look forward to having Adaline stay with us again!
Best dog boarding ever. My dog is filled with joy whenever there.
Great facility with a very caring and professional staff. Our lab loves going there.
Thank you for the support!
Thank you!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
My dog loves this place. He is so happy to go. Staff is very good.
Very loving Very nice staff and friendly and clean
The staff are all wonderful. Knowledgeable and trustworthy. I felt confident that my dogs were in capable and friendly hands.

Excellent choice for pet boarding! We’ve boarded our dog Lily during our last two family vacations and both were a great success. She’s well taken care of and comes home happy. I love the live cams during the day that let us watch our dog wander around and play with the other dogs. Price is very reasonable for the service offered. Everyone working here is very friendly and helpful. We will certainly continue to use canine retreat for future boarding needs!

1st time here and love it here, I like the process they do for a newcomer to feel comfortable. I like how you get to watch in person and alive camera. I don't like that the dogs have to be fixed at 7mos, but I understand why.

Great professionals that take good care of your pet. The facility gives dogs plenty  of room to move around and socialize with other dogs, or find a corner to chill when the dog needs to take a break from socializing.
Chloe was very helpful and is exceptional at her job!
Always a pleasure to work with the folks here. We'll be back!
